"""Build all-case tables and fixed native comparisons after actual quality review."""
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V171-matching-residual-v1'
assert read(root/'native-viewing-completion-v1.json')['native_figures']==60
assert read(root/'training-audit-v1.json')['status'].startswith('pass-')
assert read(root/'quality-audit-v1.json')['status'].startswith('pass-')
notes=root/'human-quality-notes-v1.md';assert len(notes.read_text())>300
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');execution=read(root/'execution-completion-v1.json');paired=read(root/'paired-comparisons-v1.json');audit=read(root/'quality-audit-v1.json')
summaries={(s['kind'],s['condition'],s['cohort'],s['method']):s for s in paired['summary']}
methods=['parent','V168-EMA','V169-EMA','V171-raw','V171-EMA'];columns=['V143 parent','V168 EMA','V169 EMA','V171 raw','V171 EMA']
text='# V171 learned matching RGB residual: completed quality\n\n'+notes.read_text().strip()+'\n\n'
text+='[Final evidence and exact sources](results/v171-matching-residual-final-v1.json) · [Native pixels, source ROIs, checkpoint, noise and display metadata](images/v171-matching-residual-v1/manifest-v1.json).\n\n'
cells=[];lines=[]
def table(title,specifications):
 global text
 text+='## '+title+'\n\n| Metric | '+' | '.join(columns)+' |\n| --- | '+' | '.join(['---:']*len(columns))+' |\n'
 for label,kind,condition,cohort,field,digits in specifications:
  values=[]
  for method in methods:
   value=summaries[kind,condition,cohort,method][field];rendered=f'{value:.{digits}f}'
   cells.append(dict(kind=kind,condition=condition,cohort=cohort,method=method,field=field,digits=digits,rendered=rendered));values.append(rendered)
  line='| '+label+' | '+' | '.join(values)+' |';lines.append(line);text+=line+'\n'
 text+='\n'
table('Mesh response and actual blank error',[(('Present' if present else 'Absent')+' '+label,'mesh',present,None,field,digits) for present in [True,False] for label,field,digits in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16',6),('signed template gain','template_gain',8),('actual blank RMS','blank_error_RMS_DN16',6),('blank spatial RMS','blank_spatial_RMS_DN16',6),('blank DC RMS','blank_DC_RMS_DN16',6)]])
table('Quiet fields beside detail',[(f'{prior} {label}','mixed-quiet',prior,None,field,6) for prior in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior'] for label,field in [('whole RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('quiet RMS','quiet_error_RMS_DN16'),('quiet spatial RMS','quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16'),('quiet DC RMS','crop_DC_RMS_DN16')]])
table('Native 512-pixel standalone flats',[(f'{prior} {label}','flat',prior,'fresh-flat512',field,6) for prior in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('spatial RMS','full_spatial_RMS_DN16'),('coarse32 RMS','block32_RMS_DN16')]])
table('Natural photographic detail',[(f'{cohort}/{variant} {label}','photo',variant,cohort,field,6) for cohort in ['retained512','organic384'] for variant in ['photo-faint','photo-dark'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('band response','crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain'),('band error','crop_relative_band_error')]])
design=read(plan['design']['path']);adc=next(c for c in design['observations'] if c.get('cohort')=='adc-photo256')
table('ADC-only controls',[(f'Photo {label}','photo',adc['variant']['name'],adc['cohort'],field,6) for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('band error','crop_relative_band_error')]]+[(f'{cohort} {label}','flat','adc-only',cohort,field,6) for cohort in ['fresh-flat512','adc-sloped512'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('coarse32 RMS','block32_RMS_DN16')]])
text+='RMS values are camera-RGB DN16. Signed template gain 1 means exact constructed mesh amplitude; a small signed absent mean does not certify absence of artifacts. Coarse32 is spatially centered block-mean error. All paired differences and decrease/increase counts are retained. The reused, adaptively studied cohort does not establish blind generalization or training-seed uncertainty.\n\n'
text+='## Architecture, training and evidence\n\n'
text+='A fresh 2,088,906-parameter matching network predicts RGB residuals above frozen V169 EMA and its cached V143/DINO parent. It reuses the [pinned April 2026 NLFeMF definitions](https://github.com/MIA-UIB/nonlocal-matchfilter), with width 16, nine neighbors per scale and three scales. Inputs are the existing 39 physical RAW-innovation/noise/CFA/white-balance/parent features. A zero 12-channel tail gives exact V169 initial output; supplied image noise RMS scales the RGB correction. Raw/EMA refer to the new residual; V169 EMA stays fixed in both. No released V170 weights are loaded. New matching weights train from scratch on the existing free-image and synthetic cache. All 93 prior neural source files remain unchanged.\n\n'
text+='The fixed cache contains 341 mesh, 243 photo, 156 mixed, 153 flat and 107 weak-detail batches, including V168\'s fine-wire/contrast ladder. Inputs, parents, noise and coupled-pair units are reused exactly. Losses combine pixel/gradient reconstruction, paired differences, paired common error, clean-flat anchoring and local/DC regret relative to V169. Targets, pairs and masks never enter inference. The old spectral-head loss is omitted: architecture and objective changes are not isolated. These losses provide no unseen noisy-flat guarantee. Zero supplied variance bypasses the new branch and retains V169 exactly.\n\n'
text+=f"The 1,000-row schedule completes {execution['actual_training_optimizer_updates']:,} AdamW updates and skips {execution['training_ADC_skips']} ADC-only rows without model/optimizer evaluation. Learning rate starts at 0.0003 with 50-row warmup and cosine decay; gradients clip at 1 and EMA is retained. A real step-8 checkpoint restores model, Adam, EMA and RNG state exactly, then continues at step 9 without prefix replay. All 141 trainable tensors receive nonzero gradients during the run; 141 final Adam states and both endpoint tensors are finite and checked. Frozen V169 weights and RNG state stay unchanged.\n\n"
text+='All 114 relevant CPU tests pass, including six new phase-order/routing/frozen-parent cases. Eight independent NumPy adjoint fixtures cover CPU/CUDA, FP32/FP64 and 1×1/3×3 sampling. Full-network CPU/CUDA forward and input gradients agree within the admitted tolerance. Three batch-4 native 512 backward cases and native 768 inference pass. The upstream CUDA grad-input kernel explicitly uses atomic addition; warn-only deterministic mode records this. Exact checkpoint restoration does not imply bit-exact retraining.\n\n'
text+='Two synthetic admission failures are preserved: an incorrect initial all-nonzero gradient assertion, and reading `.grad` from a non-leaf device input. The first exposed the upstream zero-initialized offset tail: 50 earlier tensors initially receive zero gradients. Corrected admission verifies finite gradients and later activation. Neither failure used held-out data or changed inference sources. [Original protocol](results/v171-matching-residual-v1/original-protocol-v1.md) · [Preparation and exact sources](results/v171-matching-residual-preparation-v1.json) · [CPU readiness](results/v171-CPU-readiness-v1.json).\n\n'
training_audit=read(root/'training-audit-v1.json')
text+=f"All 1,000 training input/parent/unit bindings and durable rows are audited. NumPy FP32 independently checks {training_audit['FP32_loss_totals_checked']} actual weighted loss totals. Clean-mask fingerprints reproduce previously independently audited V168 masks on identical targets; this is inheritance validation, not a new independent mask construction. No new source/noise, parent/DINO or original/dataz reads occur.\n\n"
text+=f"Quality uses 1,644 composed calls, each with frozen V169 evaluation; the matching network runs 1,500 times with 7,500 nested sampling calls. All 1,644 frozen V169 outputs replay their existing fingerprints exactly, including 144 ADC-only outputs retained exactly by the final result. All 6,576 actual input fingerprints, durable method rows and event bindings are checked. Independent in-process FP32 addition covers {audit['allcase_inprocess_addition_channels']:,} channels.\n\n"
text+=f"Full new arrays cover only 36 preselected native cases: 72 RGB and 72 residual arrays, totaling 430,196,736 bytes. Separate posthoc metrics and addition checks cover all those arrays, {audit['scalar_checks']:,} scalar values and {audit['independent_native_addition_channels']:,} RGB channels. Other new outputs were scored/fingerprinted and norm/decomposition/addition checked in process but not retained. There is no complete new full-array archive or all-822 new-array posthoc audit. Independent Decimal arithmetic checks {paired['independent_Decimal_mean_checks']} grouped means.\n\n"
text+=f"Actual new matching calls, including all admission attempts, are {execution['total_new_matching_CUDA_calls']:,} CUDA and 3 CPU. Frozen-component CUDA calls are {execution['total_frozen_component_CUDA_calls']:,}; these are nested components rather than extra DINO-parent calls. Admission includes 3 discarded synthetic updates and 8 sampler-only fixtures. Peak training/quality CUDA allocations are {execution['peak_training_CUDA_allocated_bytes']/2**30:.6f}/{execution['peak_quality_CUDA_allocated_bytes']/2**30:.6f} GiB. Patch intervals do not establish full-frame speed; no 100MP/10-second claim is made. Both scientific owners are terminal.\n\n"
text+='The bounded trial declares 52/114 GiB local/external reserves plus a 0.5 GiB projection margin, 32 GiB runtime RAM and 24 GiB CUDA. Older guards and receipt bytes remain unchanged. The inherited MIT notices and embedded sampler Caffe notices remain in provenance.\n\n'
text+='## Native comparisons\n\n'
text+='All 60 figures were actually viewed in 15 original-detail sheets: 48 boards and 12 noisy/restored/exact constructed GT triplets. Every cell has 160×160 native pixels without resizing. Source/ROI, checkpoint hash, noise conditioning, camera transform, exposure, contrast and anchor are in the manifest. The synthetic mesh uses RGGB 512, ROI `[176,176,160,160]`, shot 0.00128/read variance 6.5536e-6, exposure 8 and contrast 1/40. Quiet fields use ROI `[80,176,160,160]`, exposure 8 and contrast 40; flats use ROI `[176,176,160,160]`, exposure 4 and contrast 40. ISO12800 uses shot 0.00256/read variance 2.62144e-5. Photographic credits/licenses remain in the [V168 source report](fine-mesh-training.md#photographic-credits).\n\n'
text+='The main DSCF3879/3880 scene includes sky, building, foliage and coarse fence at exposure 4. Cab DSCF3842/3835 includes both noise priors, both native windows `[206,229,160,160]` and `[426,189,160,160]` in 768-pixel contexts, exposure 16, and both camera JPEGs. Separate ISO100/AHD/JPEG references differ in aperture, shutter, motion and processing; they are qualitative references, not exact GT, and are not pixelwise scored. Captures, JPEGs and siblings remain excluded from training and originals read-only. [Main scene](../configs/gfx-qualitative-20231231.json) · [Fine cab mesh](../configs/gfx-green-mesh-20231231.json).\n\n'
figures=read(root/'figures-v1.json')
for triplet,title in [(False,'All native comparison boards'),(True,'Noisy, restored and exact constructed GT triplets')]:
 text+='### '+title+'\n\n'
 for item in figures['images']:
  if item['triplet']!=triplet:continue
  text+=f"{item['case']['id']}; ROI `{item['ROI_xywh']}`, exposure {item['exposure']:g}, contrast {item['contrast']:g}.\n\n![Native comparison](images/v171-matching-residual-v1/{Path(item['image']['path']).name})\n\n"
text+='[Independent publication verification](results/v171-matching-residual-publication-verification-v1.json).\n'
report=repo/'docs/learned-matching-residual.md';report.write_text(text)
save(root/'report-bindings-v1.json',dict(status='built-from-completed-audits-and-actual-native-notes',report=ref(report),notes=ref(notes),cells=cells,lines=lines,source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text())))
print('Built',len(cells),'metric cells;60 native figures')
